caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object resembling a pitcher or vessel with a spout and a handle, placed on a flat, round base resembling a saucer. The object is rendered in shades of gray and brown, with highlights and shadows that suggest a reflective, metallic surface. The pitcher has a cylindrical body, a wide circular base that merges into the saucer, a pronounced and elongated spout extending upward and outward, and a handle attached to one side. A circular lid with a small ring handle sits atop the cylinder. The background is a plain, light beige color without additional elements. Small text near the bottom right of the image reads "DEL 390-I JAMES M. LAWSON" in fine print.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
